display.purpose: The single H1, one line on desktop.

title.purpose: Sub-headings, step titles, FAQ questions, the offer line.

label.purpose: Captions, buttons, table row labels. Sentence case.

figures.purpose: Odometer stats, step numbers and phone numbers, in tabular lining figures.

shadows.name: odometer-fade
shadows.value: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg), transparent 26%, transparent 74%, var(--bg)) at 70% opacity
shadows.purpose: Inner fade on odometer cells so the digits read as a rolling wheel. The only depth effect in the system.

motion.name: dur-ui
motion.purpose: Menu panel, menu icon cross-fade, FAQ answer, form messages, hover fills.

motion.name: odometer
motion.purpose: Authored moment: stats roll into place on scroll-in.

motion.name: hero-opening
motion.value: letterbox 1.3s ease-in-out; push 2.8s ease-out; words .95s ease-out from .75s, 90ms apart; copy .8s from 1.25s
motion.purpose: Authored moment: the hero opens like a film, once, on load.

motion.name: hero-video
motion.value: fade in 1.4s ease-out at 2.4s, desktop only
motion.purpose: Muted graded loop behind the hero; pauses off screen; visible pause button.

components.name: Call Button on Black
components.description: The primary action on dark bands: call the shop.
components.css: .ds-btn-solid { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: 2px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; font: 600 15px/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-btn-solid:hover { background: #A3A39E; } .ds-btn-solid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-solid:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Line Button on Black
components.description: Secondary action (Get a Quote) beside the Call button, outside the first viewport.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid #FFFFFF; color: #FFFFFF; background: transparent; font: 600 15px/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-btn-line:hover { background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-line:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Field on Black
components.description: Quote form field with its label and inline error.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font: 600 14px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-field input { min-height: 50px; padding: 12px 14px; font: 400 16px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #FFFFFF; background: #141414; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-field em { font-style: normal; font-size: 14px; color: #FF9F8E; }

components.name: Header Bar
components.description: Wordmark, quiet links, phone number after a hairline.
components.html: JB AutomotiveServicesReviewsVisitFAQ(905) 276-2732
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; min-height: 72px; padding: 0 24px; background: #000000; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mark { font: 400 1.45rem/1 Marcellus, serif; color: #FFFFFF; text-decoration: none; } .ds-links { display: flex; gap: 20px; margin-left: auto; } .ds-links a { color: #A3A39E; text-decoration: none; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-links a:hover { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-tel { padding-left: 16px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16); color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; text-decoration: none; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tel:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

components.name: Customer Quote
components.description: Customers' words set as display text, the page's evidence.
components.css: .ds-quote { margin: 0; padding: 24px; background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-quote blockquote { margin: 0 0 14px; font: 400 1.9rem/1.3 Marcellus, serif; color: #000000; max-width: 34ch; } .ds-quote figcaption { font: 400 14px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5C5C57; }

components.name: Odometer Stat
components.description: Signature: a stat whose digits roll into place like a car odometer.
components.css: .ds-odo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; padding: 32px; background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-odo-num { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; font: 400 5rem/1.15 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; color: #000000; } .ds-odo-num > span:not(.ds-dot) { padding: 0 .04em; background: #F3F3F0; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-odo-label { font: 400 15px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5C5C57; }

narrative.overview: A family repair shop presented the way a high-end service house presents itself: silence, black and white, and nothing on the page that is not doing a job. Trust comes from restraint. The shop does not shout about honesty; the page is calm enough that customers' own words, set large in a flared serif, carry the argument. The page alternates full black and full white bands. Each band holds one idea, set wide, with a lot of empty space around it. Photography is the only texture and the only warmth: every photo carries the same muted colour grade (about 60% saturation, a slightly warm cast, a touch of shadow depth), and each screen gets at most one decisive frame, either full width or cropped beside text. The interface itself has no accent colour; emphasis comes from size, the serif, and white on black. Motion has two authored moments: the hero opening (the letterbox opens from the centre, the photo settles from a slow push-in, the headline words rise in turn), and the odometer digits rolling into place. On desktop a muted, graded video loop then fades in behind the hero, with a visible pause button. Everything else answers a visitor's own action (a button press, the menu, an FAQ answer, a form error).
keyCharacteristics: True black and white bands, two greys, no accent colour.
Marcellus for every heading and every customer quote; Hanken Grotesk for reading and controls.
Muted colour photography (about 60% saturation, slightly warm), square-edged, never under text.
Hairline rules (1px) are the only structure: no cards, no boxes, no shadows on content.
Buttons are near-square solid blocks (2px corners).

rules.name: The No Accent Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the interface is coloured except form errors; the photographs carry the only warmth. Emphasis is size, the serif, or white on black.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Bands alternate full black and full white, never two of the same tone side by side, except the quote band and the footer, which a hairline separates. Every component reads its colours from the band it sits in.

rules.name: The Lining Figures Rule
rules.body: Marcellus has old-style figures (the 7 and 9 drop below the line). Any number that must read cleanly (stats, steps, phone numbers) is set in Hanken Grotesk with tabular lining figures.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks Rule
rules.body: Headings and customers' words use the serif; everything a visitor operates uses the sans.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is 1px rules. No cards, no boxed panels, no drop shadows.

dos: Do give every photograph the same muted colour grade (saturation 0.6, a slight warm cast, linear 1.05 / -6) and each screen one decisive frame.
Do alternate black and white bands, and let components read their colours from the band.
Do set customer quotes large in Marcellus; they are the page's evidence.
Do use Hanken tabular lining figures for every number that has to read cleanly.
Do keep one solid button in the first viewport (Call), with Get a Quote as a text link.
donts: Don't add an accent colour, a gradient or a tint to the interface; colour lives in the photographs and the form error only.
Don't put text over a photograph.
Don't box content into cards or add drop shadows; use hairline rules.
Don't add eyebrow labels above headings or uppercase tracked labels.
Don't use Marcellus for numbers in stats or phone numbers.
Don't add scroll-triggered fade-ins to sections; the hero opening and the odometer are the only authored moments.
Don't autoplay any other media, and never ship the hero video without its pause button.
